phase_name: Deploy and verify the recorder standalone

objectives.description: Deploy via deploy-headless.sh; add system-defect-record.sh to manifest.json scripts array (deploy engine copies only manifest-declared entries)
Positive test attributed to skill-base.sh; found and fixed two recorder bugs (jq . rebinding in scope-root stripping; missing -n on two jq calls reading empty stdin)
Recursion guard suppression test (attributed to system-defect-record.sh itself)
Dedup test (suppress with non-terminal linked_task_number; record when unlinked); found and fixed ARG_MAX bug reading state.json via --argjson, switched to --slurpfile
Loud degradation test (missing critical-paths file, exit 2)
Signal B refusal test (exit 3) and non-fatal contract scratch-harness test
Restore specs/events.jsonl to pre-phase baseline (911 lines); git diff --stat shows zero diff

approaches_tried.approach: jq map(select($p == . or ($p | startswith(. + "/")))) for scope-root stripping
approaches_tried.reason: the piped startswith(. + "/") argument rebinds . to $p before evaluating the argument, so the intended per-element root reference is lost -- fixed via map(. as $r | ...)

approaches_tried.approach: jq -r --arg ... '...' (no -n flag) for normalized_attributed_path and sm_hit
approaches_tried.reason: no stdin document was supplied and -n was omitted, so the invocation silently produced empty output under $(...) substitution -- fixed by adding -n

approaches_tried.approach: jq -n --argjson state "$(jq -c '.' state.json)" for the dedup lookup
approaches_tried.reason: state.json is large (hundreds of historical tasks); passing its content as a command-line argument exceeded ARG_MAX ("Argument list too long") -- fixed via --slurpfile state_arr "$STATE_FILE"

deviations.description: Deploy engine requires manifest-declared scripts; system-defect-record.sh was not yet declared
deviations.reason: Necessary correction to make Phase 2's deliverable deployable; discovered during Phase 3's own deploy step
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- added manifest.json entry, in-scope correction)*
